items.a: Absolutely. MacDiskCleaner only deletes files you explicitly approve. Everything is moved to Trash before permanent removal, so nothing is ever unrecoverable, and it never touches system files it hasn't verified are safe to remove.

items.q: Will it work on my Mac?
items.a: Yes. MacDiskCleaner supports macOS 14 Sonoma and later, including the latest macOS release, on both Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4) and Intel Macs — no Rosetta required.

items.q: Is the free version really free?
items.a: Yes. There is no trial period and nothing expires: scanning and browsing every result are free forever, and you can clean up 2 GB in total at no cost. After 2 GB, the app asks for Pro or a license key before deleting more.

Pro removes the 2 GB free cleanup cap and adds four tools the free tier doesn't include: the App Uninstaller (removes leftover support files, not just the app), Privacy Cleaner, Startup Manager, and Scheduled Scans — plus lifetime updates and priority support, all for a single $12.99 payment.
No. Pro is a one-time $12.99 payment — no recurring billing, ever. You own your license.

items.q: How many Macs can I use one license on?
items.a: Each Pro license activates on one Mac. Getting a new Mac? Choose Deactivate License in the old app (or contact support) and activate it on the new one. Need more Macs? Contact support.
Yes — a full 30-day, no-questions-asked refund on all Pro purchases. Email support@macdiskcleaner.com with your license key.

items.q: How is this different from CleanMyMac or OnyX?
items.a: MacDiskCleaner is a one-time purchase with no subscription, unlike CleanMyMac's recurring plans, and it includes a guided duplicate finder and large-file scanner that OnyX doesn't have. See our full feature-by-feature comparison for details.

items.q: Does it collect or upload my data?
items.a: No. All scanning, duplicate detection, and cleanup analysis happen entirely on your Mac. No file contents, file names, or folder paths are ever sent to a server — the license check is the only thing that talks to our servers, and it only sends your license key, nothing about your files.

items.q: Is pricing the same for US customers?
items.a: Yes — $12.99 USD is the price everywhere, charged once through our payment processor with standard US card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay support at checkout. No regional markup.
Use the Contact page to reach support directly, or email support@macdiskcleaner.com. We reply to every message, and Pro customers get priority handling.

items.q: Do I need an internet connection to use it?
items.a: Only briefly, to activate your Pro license the first time and to check for updates. Scanning and cleaning both work fully offline.

downloadStarter.firstTime: Opening it the first time (takes 20 seconds, only once):
downloadStarter.step1: Open the downloaded MacDiskCleaner.dmg and drag MacDiskCleaner into the Applications folder.
downloadStarter.step2: Open MacDiskCleaner from Applications. macOS shows "Apple could not verify…" — click Done. Never click "Move to Bin".
downloadStarter.step3: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down to "MacDiskCleaner was blocked", click Open Anyway and confirm with your password.
downloadStarter.step4: Done — from now on it opens normally, and updates install themselves with no warning.
